items.source:
Build an error message for an SQL script execution failure,
based on the supplied arguments.
items.translation: 根据提供的参数，构建一个 SQL 脚本执行失败的错误消息。

items.source: stmtNumber - the statement number in the SQL script (i.e., the nth statement present in the resource)
items.translation: stmtNumber - SQL 脚本中的语句编号（即资源中存在的第 n 条语句）

items.source: stmt - the actual SQL statement that failed
items.translation: stmt - 实际失败的 SQL 语句

items.source: encodedResource - the resource from which the SQL statement was read
items.translation: encodedResource - 读取 SQL 语句的资源

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen, Mark Paluch
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen, Mark Paluch

items.source: Thrown by ScriptUtils if a statement in an SQL script failed when executing it against the target database.
items.translation: 由 `ScriptUtils` 抛出，当 SQL 脚本中的某个语句在针对目标数据库执行时失败。

items.source: cause - the underlying cause of the failure
an error message suitable for an exception's detail message or logging
items.translation: 适合异常详细信息消息或日志的错误消息。
